name: Bloodmage Lynnore
summary: Near the Blasted Lands' northern entrance, Bloodmage Lynnore studies the power within local beasts. She camps with her brother Drazial and brews draughts from their organs.

sections.title: Master of Blood Magic
sections.body: Near the northern entrance to the Blasted Lands, Bloodmage Lynnore studies blood magic with her brother Drazial. Few elves in the Eastern Kingdoms practice this forbidden art. The land is harsh and corrupting, yet Lynnore searches native beasts for arcane and vital energies. Travelers bring her brains and gizzards from local animals. She distills them into elixirs that sharpen intellect and spirit.

faq.answer: Bloodmage Lynnore is a blood elf blood mage camped near the Blasted Lands' northern entrance. Travelers bring her beast parts for powerful concoctions that enhance their abilities.

faq.q: Where can Bloodmage Lynnore be found?
faq.answer: Lynnore camps with her brother, Bloodmage Drazial, near the Blasted Lands' northern entrance. Their camp lies where the pass from the Swamp of Sorrows opens onto the wastes.

Lynnore brews rare tonics from local wildlife, including basilisk brains, vulture gizzards, and snickerfang jowls. Her Cerebral Cortex Compound and Gizzard Gum enhance intellect and spirit for a long time.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, you can trade with Lynnore in the Blasted Lands. She offers unique concoctions to anyone from either faction who brings her the raw ingredients.
As a mage drawn to unconventional spellcraft, you can look to Lynnore's rare and controversial arcane path. She manipulates vital essence instead of conventional ley energies.
